extracted.name: Chocolate fiber cookies
extracted.description: My sweet Mother in law Analí wanted to incorporate more fiber in her daily sweet snacks. So she made up this recipe, they’re delicious 😋🤍 I added a bit of my touch to the recipe.
ingredient_lines: 1/4 cup even portion of chia, flaxseed & sliced almonds
instruction_lines: Bring all ingredients in a bowl. Flour, oats, mixture of seeds & nuts, Cacao powder, honey or maple syrup, 2 eggs & cooking oil
Mold the mixture to individual cookies. Should have enough to make 15 individual cookies.
